# Precision ledger - measured samples

Offline recheck of saved bytes and original proof/link/role constraints; no live re-fetch and no output edits. No item is silently removed. Correct/doubtful/wrong are automated saved-evidence verdicts, not human-labelled accuracy. The separate human-review column records explicit user verdicts for the exact sample/value, without upgrading original proof tiers. Remaining unreviewed doubtful/wrong items need hand review.

Method and limits:

- Automated verdicts are rule checks, not independent human precision ground truth.
- correct means clear under saved evidence rules at retrieval, not guaranteed current internet truth.
- Name/cross-entity/group/historical concerns are doubtful even if publication identity checks passed.
- Foreign counterparties/parents are legitimate; exact country/ID must match the target role, not every party in a batch.

Checks: SHA-256 and verbatim excerpts; website exact number, replayed proof, registry spelling, other owner numbers and group context; social strict own header/footer link, handle/numeric LinkedIn rule and founder/agency exclusion; jobs current at retrieval with exact employer/proven subunit or own careers link; GLEIF exact Norwegian registry identity and ACTIVE parent relationship; TED exact Norwegian buyer/selected tenderer and structured lot/contract award link.
